en: Welcome! How can I help you?
text: Bine ai venit! Cu ce te pot ajuta?

en: Pokémon can be sweet, or they can be fierce. It's up to the trainer who raises them.
text: Pokémonii pot fi blânzi sau pot fi fioroși. Depinde de Antrenorul care-i crește.

en: Team Rocket? They're a bunch of thieves. They'd steal Pokémon from anyone!
text: Echipa Rocket? O adunătură de hoți. Ar fura Pokémoni de la oricine!
